flavor.ruby: Instead of blood, a powerful magnetic force courses throughout BELDUM’s body. This POKéMON communicates with others by sending controlled pulses of magnetism.
flavor.sapphire: BELDUM keeps itself floating by generating a magnetic force that repels earth’s natural magnetism. When it sleeps, this POKéMON anchors itself to a cliff using the hooks on its rear.
flavor.emerald: When BELDUM gather in a swarm, they move in perfect unison as if they were but one POKéMON. They communicate with each other using brain waves.
flavor.firered: It uses magnetic waves to converse with its kind. All the cells in its body are magnetic.
flavor.leafgreen: It uses magnetic waves to converse with its kind. All the cells in its body are magnetic.
